name: Quick Polls
description: Create quick polls that anyone can vote on and watch the results
backend_requirements: Access control: anyone may view polls and vote; require auth for creating and deleting polls; admin endpoints are restricted to the admin account

POST /api/polls creates a poll for the signed-in user from a question and its options; options is a list of 2 to 6 distinct option texts, and when it is omitted or empty the poll gets the two options 'Yes' and 'No'

Poll validation: question is a required non-empty string of at most 500 characters; each option text is a non-empty string of at most 200 characters; a list with one option, more than six, or a repeated text (ignoring case) answers 400
Options keep the order they were given in; position numbers them 1, 2, 3 ... within their poll
POST /api/polls/:id/vote takes the position of the chosen option and adds 1 to its votes; every call counts as one vote, and an unknown position answers 400
Every poll in a response carries its options (id, position, text, votes) in position order and total_votes, the sum of their votes
GET /api/polls returns active polls, newest first; ?page= and ?page_size= page the result (page_size default 20, at most 100), and total counts every active poll
Only the user who created a poll may delete it (403 for anyone else); DELETE /api/polls/:id removes the poll, its options and their votes permanently
Deactivated polls (is_active false) are left out of GET /api/polls, answer 404 on GET /api/polls/:id and reject votes with 404; the admin overview still lists them
Errors answer with a JSON object {"detail": "<message>"}: 400 for invalid input, 401 without a valid token, 403 for a non-owner or a non-admin, 404 for unknown ids
frontend_requirements: Everyone sees the poll list and can vote; signed-in users also get the create form and a delete button on their own polls, and visitors see a 'Sign in to create polls' prompt in place of the form
Sign-in and registration forms that call /api/auth/login and /api/auth/register; keep the token for later requests, show the signed-in username and offer sign-out
Each poll shows its question and one vote button per option; after a vote the counts update at once from the API's answer and the poll switches to its results
Results: a horizontal bar per option with its vote count and share of total_votes in percent
The browser remembers which polls this visitor has voted on and shows those polls as results, without vote buttons
Create poll form: a question field and option fields that can be added (up to six) and removed (down to two), showing the API's validation messages
Show loading and empty states, and previous/next paging for the poll list
admin_requirements: Admin overview: every poll, active or not, with its creator and total votes, plus total, active and inactive counts
Toggle a poll's active status from the overview

fields.user_id: integer (references the signed-in user who created it)
fields.is_active: boolean (default true; false hides the poll from public endpoints and stops voting)
